title: Chelation
description: Molecules with many grips wrap a metal ion and will not let go, the tighter-held ions first. Unlocks EDTA and the Chelation Column.

puzzle.goal: A column catches a metal with binding K at dose c and flow f, each pass removing a share 1 − e^(−Kc/f). Write the share x removed.
puzzle.name: Breakthrough
puzzle.ask: Find x for K = @{K}, c = @{c} and f = @{f}.
puzzle.method: Each slice of the column catches the same share of what reaches it: the survivors fall off exponentially.
